reply_text:
I told Dana in a thread on her #north-team message that the settled seat count for Quarrendon Freight Lines' 2026 renewal is 100 seats.

On Oct 14 Ilse posted 261 in #north-team, then corrected it to 100 the same morning in #north-random, saying she'd read the wrong line. I told Dana to put 100 in the tracker, not 261, and that Ilse can confirm it if she wants to be sure.

Dana is a member of #north-random, so she could already see the correction. A seat count is an account detail, not a finance figure, so there was nothing to approve.
